goal: Validate numeric configuration arguments to prevent negative values and integer overflows
Prevent severe edge cases like stuck initial block download, unbounded memory usage, and fee fallbacks
agreement: Concept approval to fix misconfiguration bugs and broken negation handling (fjahr, l0rinc, ryanofsky)
Approach objection arguing bounds validation should be handled centrally in the args parser (sedited)
Objection that manual parsing at call sites bloats code and removes saturation behavior (maflcko)
Objection that a new test loop binds temporary string references and causes CI failure (l0rinc)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it prevents misconfiguration bugs that can stall initial block download or disable flushing
Node operators benefit from clear rejections at startup rather than silent fallback fees or memory bloat
